# warpbuild_runner_image (Data Source)

Looks up an existing runner image by alias.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "warpbuild_runner_image" "existing" {
  alias = "my-custom-image"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias` (String) Image alias to look up.

### Read-Only

- `arch` (String) CPU architecture.
- `id` (String) Runner image ID.
- `os` (String) Operating system.
- `stack_id` (String) Stack the image belongs to.
- `status` (String) Image status.
- `type` (String) Image type (e.g. `byoc_ami`).
